metadata.source: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database (SBDB) Query API, ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb_query.api
metadata.query: sb-class=MBA AND name is defined (name|DF) -- every real IAU-named main-belt asteroid
metadata.coordinate_frame: Heliocentric ecliptic J2000 osculating orbital elements (a, e, i, om, w, ma at epoch)
metadata.companion_dataset: sbdb_asteroids_54.json -- a curated highlight subset (top-50-by-brightness + the 4 NEO mission-target hero asteroids: Bennu/Ryugu/Itokawa/Eros, which are NOT included here since they are NEO class, not MBA)
metadata.not_yet_done: Not wired into test_shootout.py / test_minor_bodies_predictions.py validation, no propagated 30-year forecast generated for these bodies, not yet consumed by build_solar_system_theater.py or cross-checked against misc/BELT_STATISTICS.md's procedural composition-class statistics.
metadata.note: SHA-256 binds created_utc to the data array -- same tamper-evidence pattern as ssbm_future_predictions.json.
